objects.description: During [C0017](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0017), [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) exfiltrated victim data via DNS lookups by encoding and prepending it as subdomains to the attacker-controlled domain.(Citation: Mandiant APT41)
